Spires Cc: Shalom Bonee; Chin, Kristina; Yoly Villada; Abigail Newman; Conger, Ava; Ambler, Hayley; Payton, Gwendolyn; Briand, Elisabeth; Angeleah Eckersen; Helene Gregorich; Whitehead, Maeghan; Jennifer Seiler Avallone Subject: Re: Moller - Expert Depositions Attachments: THUNDIYIL_000002.pdf; THUNDIYIL_000001.pdf **CAUTION: External Email** Hi Hillary, Attached please find copies of the poster presentations cited on Dr. Thundiyil's updated CV and discussed during last week's deposition. Plaintiff disagrees that the disclosure on Nov. 18, 2025, failed to comply with FRCP 26(a)(2)(B) as no publications were excluded. What is cited in your email are news appearances related to public safety and poster presentations at conferences which were already thoroughly asked about and discussed during last week's deposition. Dr. Thundiyil testified that the manuscripts related to the attached posters have not been published, are undergoing peer review, and are not yet final. Dr. Thundiyil provided his updated CV during the deposition. Numerous questions were asked related to the CV. Dr. Thundiyil could not locate the final posters during the deposition and stated as much. They are provided here. Nonetheless counsel for defendants engaged in extensive questioning about the poster presentations, news appearances, and the unpublished manuscripts. All questions were answered. Plaintiff disagrees with your claim of prejudice. In fact, defense counsel closed the deposition without any objection or statement on the record of an intent to keep the deposition open given the posters had not been provided. Plaintiff will not agree to re-open the deposition of Dr. Thunidyil. It is notable that just yesterday defense expert, Dr. Huestis, referenced and relied on data related to the Nutrasource clinical study, which data has never been produced in discovery. Please have Johnson Foods produce all documents related to the Nutrasource study. Additionally, Defendants served supplemental productions over the holiday season including additional testing documents and spec sheets that were not available during the depositions of defendants such as Martian Sales, Calibre, Nuza and JOPEN. Why these documents were not produced prior to the deposition of defendants is unknown. In fact, during those same depositions defendants produced additional testing documents and stated such production was complete. That now appears to have been false. 1

Case 2:24-cv-00228-WBV-DPC Document 217-5 Filed 02/03/26 Page 4 of 10 Plaintiff’s expert disclosure on Nov. 18, 2025 for Dr. Thundiyil failed to comply with FRCP 26(a)(2)(B) as it did not include a “list of all publications authored in the previous 10 years.” Dr. Thundiyil’s CV was only current through 4/14/2025. His CV provided to Plaintiff on Friday during his deposition included multiple publications and presentations that are highly relevant to the issues in this case as they relate to studies involving mitragynine and causes of death (see below excerpts from Dr. Thundiyil’s updated CV). These publications all occurred before the Nov. 18 disclosure date. These studies came up during Dr. Thundiyil’s deposition. Defendants’ counsel repeatedly requested the materials and Dr. Thundiyil did not provide them. If these highly relevant materials had been disclosed, Defendant would have requested them in advance of Dr. Thundiyil’s deposition and been able to thoroughly question him on these topics. Defendant has been severely prejudiced by Plaintiff’s failure to comply with FRCP 26(a)(2)(B). As a result, Defendant requests that Plaintiff immediately provide all documents related to the below materials and that Plaintiff confirm that Dr. Thundiyil can be re-deposed on these topics. Please let us know if you agree or whether we need to raise this with the Court. Page 17: 3
